_comment: Every NEW user-facing string F2 introduces, for Brad's review. Whitespace is collapsed before matching, so JSX line-wraps do not matter. Wording mirrors existing vendor-flow copy: the 'not complete until ... all 3 required product photos' sentence is VendorRegisterSuccess.tsx's; the 'no longer valid ... contact SAOC if you believe this is an error' sentence is the stand-payment page's; 'Product photo N' labels and the 'N/3 photos' count are the success page and admin table's. No apostrophes in any string, so no entity-escaping variants. Amendment (beta c11b51bd live-count defect): the upload-state strings moved into the client component components/vendors/VendorPhotoResumeUploads.tsx so the count and completion update after each upload; the page keeps the invalid, server-side complete, hero and metadata strings. NO new wording was introduced by the amendment: the completion sentence is the page's existing server-complete sentence, now also shown by the component the moment the third upload succeeds. (VendorRegisterSuccess's 'Your registration is complete.' tail is NOT adopted, to avoid new copy on this page.)
